story.title: Pilot Warned of Excess Speed Before Miami Runway Overshoot
story.summary: An Amazon cargo plane overshot the runway in Miami, resulting in an incident that involved five people. The pilot had warned the co-pilot that they were approaching too fast as they prepared for landing.

timeline_highlights.title: Fatal Amazon Cargo Plane Crash at Miami International Airport
timeline_highlights.summary: An Amazon cargo plane crashed at Miami International Airport after overrunning the runway, resulting in five fatalities and five injuries. The incident occurred when the plane, arriving from Puerto Rico, struck several vehicles on the ground. Investigations by the FAA and NTSB are underway to determine the cause of the crash.
key_facts: Five people were killed and five injured in the crash.
The cargo plane overran the runway and hit vehicles.
The FAA and NTSB are investigating the incident.

timeline_highlights.title: Fatal Amazon Cargo Plane Crash in Miami Under Investigation
timeline_highlights.summary: An Amazon cargo plane overran the runway at Miami International Airport, resulting in a crash that killed five people and injured five others. The aircraft struck two vehicles on the ground, including a cleaning crew van and an SUV. Investigators have recovered the flight data and cockpit voice recorders as the FAA and NTSB begin their investigation into the incident.

timeline_highlights.title: Cargo Jet Attempted to Abort Landing Before Fatal Miami Crash
timeline_highlights.summary: Flight data indicates that an Amazon cargo plane attempted to abort an unsteady landing at Miami International Airport before crashing into a van, resulting in the deaths of five individuals inside the vehicle. The victims were identified as employees of a cleaning service contracted by airlines. Two additional people were reported to be in critical condition following the incident.

The crash occurred at Miami International Airport.
Five people in a van were killed in the crash.
The van was used by a cleaning service for airlines.
Two individuals remain in critical condition.

related_stories.title: Céline Dion to Make Emotional Comeback in Paris Concert
related_stories.summary: Céline Dion is set to perform in Paris on Saturday, marking her first full concert in six years. This performance follows her battle with a rare autoimmune disorder and signifies a significant milestone in her return to the stage. The concert will take place at the Plenitude Arena, as part of her Paris residency.

related_stories.title: Teen Survives Days at Sea After Boat Capsizes in Alaska
related_stories.summary: A 15-year-old boy was found clinging to an overturned boat in the Bering Sea after surviving for approximately three days. He was fishing with his older brother and cousin when their skiff capsized, resulting in the loss of both family members. The boy was rescued by the Coast Guard.

related_stories.title: Trump Expresses Support for a Unified Ireland During Visit
related_stories.summary: During his visit to Ireland, President Donald Trump stated that he would 'love' to see Ireland reunified, calling it 'fantastic' and 'inevitable.' His comments were made while attending the Irish Open golf tournament and meeting with Irish leaders, including Micheál Martin. Trump suggested that reunification could happen soon, despite Downing Street's commitment to the Good Friday Agreement.

related_stories.title: Russian Strikes Kill Civilians in Ukraine Following Putin's Warning
related_stories.summary: Russian air strikes resulted in the deaths of three civilians and injuries to dozens more across ten regions in Ukraine. The attacks targeted various sites, including cargo vessels and industrial facilities. This escalation follows a warning from President Vladimir Putin regarding the potential consequences of European troop involvement in Ukraine.
